'''''The Annals of Applied Statistics''''' is a [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] published by the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]], covering all areas of [[statistics]], featuring papers in the applied half of this range. It was established in 2007, with [[Bradley Efron]] as founding editor-in-chief.<ref>{{cite web |url= http://bulletin.imstat.org/2012/12/ims-journal-editors/ |title=IMS Bulletin Online, IMS Journal Editors |date=19 December 2012 |accessdate=9 March 2013 }}</ref> According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2022 [[impact factor]] of 1.8.<ref name=WoS>{{cite book |year=2023|title=[[Journal Citation Reports|2022 Journal Citation Reports]] |publisher=[[Thomson Reuters]] |edition=Science |series=[[Web of Science]] }}</ref>
